name: TEXCYCL
recent: Tex Cycle 近期出现多项董事与公司秘书变动，包括薪酬委员会及董事会成员调整。最新新闻显示，公司主席 Low Chin Koon 成为 MCE Holdings 的大股东。
notable: 公司主席 Low Chin Koon 成为 MCE Holdings 的大股东。
公司出现多项董事及薪酬委员会成员变动。
earnings: 2026年6月30日季度营收为2416.1万令吉，环比增长17.3%，同比增长179.8%；净利为314.9万令吉，环比下降11.4%，同比增长4.3%；净利率为13.0%，低于上季度的17.2%。

recent_en: Tex Cycle recently saw several changes in directors and company secretary, including adjustments to the Remuneration Committee and boardroom. Latest news shows Chairman Low Chin Koon becoming a substantial shareholder of MCE Holdings.
notable_en: Chairman Low Chin Koon became a substantial shareholder of MCE Holdings.
Several changes in directors and Remuneration Committee members occurred.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR24.161 million, up 17.3% QoQ and up 179.8% YoY; net income was MYR3.149 million, down 11.4% QoQ but up 4.3% YoY; net margin was 13.0%, lower than 17.2% in the previous quarter.
